content.rationale:
This decision models the partial policy of a discard as Quint state: one call over the draft registry and the per-draft act state, in `specs/drafts/discard_partial.qnt` (module `draft_discard_partial`), in the house form of `specs/drafts/discard_commit.qnt`, `specs/drafts/discard.qnt` and `specs/drafts/state.qnt` - a module that imports the state model and the commit model, declares the act state, and exports one action that steps `records` and `acts`. The check `specs/drafts/discard_partial_check.qnt` (lkukpupp) fixes the interface this module must carry - the type `Act = Change | Forget | Remove`, the variable `acts: str -> Set[Act]`, and `action discardPartial(handles: List[str], completed: str -> Set[Act], failed: bool)` over `records` and `acts`, total over its three inputs - and the module supplies exactly that. The module imports `draft_state.*` from `./state` and `discard_commit.discardCommit` from `./discard_commit`, carries no initializer because `draft_state` already exports `init`, and defines none of the check's own `gate`-prefixed helpers, whose names the flattened TLA+ module would otherwise share.

qznqvpyr fixes the policy, and the module states exactly that policy. Its two answers are that a failure before the commit rolls no completed act back and that a second invocation goes on through an already-cleared part to the commit. `partialAfterActs` gives a named handle the acts it held before the attempt together with the acts this attempt completed - never less, so no completed act is rolled back - and gives a handle the call does not name exactly its old acts; `partialAfterActState` folds that over every handle already held and every named handle, so a handle absent from the act state gains its first acts, and no other handle appears. The acts a failed attempt completed therefore remain in `acts`, and the check's retry runs over that same state. `partialPrepared` reads the act state after the attempt, not before it: a named handle counts as prepared exactly when its three acts are complete once this attempt's `completed` acts are added, so a call that completes the last act itself reaches the commit, a call that finds every act already cleared also reaches it with `completed` empty, and a call still short of an act does not. `completed` maps a named handle to the acts this attempt completes beyond those already done, and a handle absent from it completes nothing. Because the completed acts persist across steps, the same call asked again from any reachable partial act state sees them and reaches the commit.

nytszsml fixes the commit policy, and the module delegates the commit rather than restating it. The removal is the commit point and is taken last; a call commits exactly when nothing failed, every named handle's three acts are complete and every named handle is an open record, and before that point the registry is left exactly as it stood. `discardPartial` hands `discardCommit` the named handles whose acts are complete after this attempt (`partialPrepared`) and the same `failed` flag, and that action decides between qmpskomv's accepted removal and leaving `records` untouched. So a failed attempt leaves every named record at its handle and still open - the record remains and the draft is still there to be ended - and a call that has not completed every named act, or names a landed record or an absent handle, removes nothing. The selection, the removal and the refusal at the store are not restated here: this module adds only the act state in front of the commit action, and it steps no variable but `records`, through that action, and `acts`.

tvtnokzu fixes the record's shape, its two states `open` and `landed`, and the registry map `records`; the module imports all of that from `draft_state` and restates none of it - no field, no state value, no constructor, no base and no transition of the record is defined here. Outside the module, because each is another decision and none is needed to state this one: the order of the change, workspace and directory acts among themselves; the jj invocations behind them; the verb surface, its wording, streams and exit status; the registry write's own mechanism, partial-write, atomicity and durability; and how a real discard abandons the change, forgets the workspace and removes the directory, which this model represents as act values and does not perform. The module is carried as Quint because the house checks decisions of this kind by running them: the registry and its commit are already machine artifacts, so the partial policy can be read as the act state in front of that commit and model-checked. The check's seeded registry, call pool, invariants and runs are the check's; this node states the behaviour, and no verdict about a run is content of it.
